notes.title: BIG NEWS! Our new game is on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
If you are interested in puzzle platformers with cool art style and some clever mechanics check it out on Kickstarter [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/notanumbergames/out-of-the-hat]here[/url] and try the demo for free [url=https://notanumbergames.itch.io/out-of-the-hat]here[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33979368/533ae48227d310429b859fd2154b7f3e734b013c.gif[/img]

Out of The Hat is a puzzle platformer where you will be thrown in a bizarre world inspired by the masters of the uncanny, including Tim Burton, Terry Gilliam, HP Lovecraft and many more.

You will follow the adventures of a little girl, forced to work for a maleficent magician in an old circus full of mysteries. You will face the dangers of the woods and other unusual places, but also experience the magic that this adventure brings with it.

Let us know what you think of it!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33979368/5c071474c5426860eb75ec5b1f71d9753c84c748.gif[/img]

notes.title: Helheim Update v1.02 - Bug Fixing + Privacy Settings
notes.content:
The first patch is here!
Some [b]bug fixed[/b] here and there and [b]privacy settings[/b] added.

Here is the content of version 1.02:

- [b]New:[/b] privacy settings to disable data tracking by unity via web (press the button in the bottom left corner of the screen in the main menu)

- [b]Fixed:[/b] bugged doors on the incubator arenas that won’t open
- [b]Fixed:[/b] Hella was moving in the wrong direction if the left stick was only slightly moved
- [b]Fixed:[/b] blurred screen on resolutions higher than 1920x1080
- [b]Fixed:[/b] vignetting and greyscale weren’t disappearing after player respawn
- [b]Fixed:[/b] some parts of the level weren’t loading
- [b]Fixed:[/b] wrong flamethrower timing after player respawn
- [b]Fixed:[/b] wrong camera behaviour after player respawn
- [b]Fixed:[/b] harbour navigation issues
- [b]Fixed:[/b] Vlad rune effect was continuing after player respawn
- [b]Fixed:[/b] wrong achievements unlock (Sailed, Gods Don’t Bleed, The Power Lies In The Sword)

notes.title: Helheim is out now!
notes.content: We are proud to announce that Not A Number’s debut game, Helheim, is now available for purchase on Steam! Developed in conjunction with 34BigThings, Helheim sees player charge headlong into a sci-fi version the Norse underworld as Hella, the Goddess of Death. Unleash your vengeful and godly wrath with furious attacks and abilities to reconquer your lost kingdom!
